newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's CCP-dollars rate 6.88 pct in December.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's CCP-dollars rate 6.88 pct in December.

text.p: Mexico's CCP-dollars rate, the average bank term deposit cost measured in dollars, was 6.88 percent in December, compared with 6.92 percent in November, Banco de Mexico said.
The central bank said that the rate can be used as a reference to determine the interest rate of credits denominated in dollars.
The monthly calculation of the CCP-dollars rate includes loans of foreign banks to multiple banking institutions and financing received from various export and import development banks.
